title: ChunkFlow telemetry: adaptive per-chunk metrics, span continuity, and PII mapping for streamed outputs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a ChunkFlow telemetry layer that emits adaptive per-chunk metrics (size, token_delta, latency_ms, upstream_backpressure), preserves tracing span continuity across streaming reconnects, and attaches a lightweight PII-mapping token so logs and metrics can be redacted/linked to compliance policies without storing raw content. This work ties together runtime hooks for chunk emission, the trace/span model used by our distributed tracing system, and the log-redaction adapter used by the console and incident tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Each emitted chunk from the serving runtime includes a telemetry header with chunk_id, sequence, token_delta, and latency_ms where applicable
Tracing: streaming response spans are correlated with the parent request and maintain deterministic span IDs across reconnects using a continuity token
PII mapping: runtime produces a derived pii_map_id (hash token) per chunk that allows redaction lookups without persisting raw chunk text in telemetry stores
Adaptive sampling: high-throughput clients are sampled at rate determined by a policy (per-customer, per-route) and sample decisions are surfaced in metrics
Compatibility: telemetry can be transformed by the API compatibility layer to match legacy 'stream-chunk' telemetry v1 schema used by older dashboard consumers
No sensitive plaintext from streamed content lands in ES logs or metrics; spot checks and automated tests validate redaction mappings
Docs and SDKs: Node and Python SDKs expose a deterministic continuity_token API and documentation for instrumenting client reconnects
updates: 2025-02-12 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket after spike with runtime team. Spike showed feasibility of adding chunk headers at the transport layer; prototype attached in PR notes.

2025-02-14 - Marcus Li: Implemented initial header emission in internal branch. Chunk metadata shape: {chunk_id, seq, token_delta, latency_ms, continuity_token, pii_map_id}. See PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8421

2025-02-16 - Priya Rao (Security): Reviewed PII mapping approach. Requested that pii_map_id be HMAC-SHA256 with a rotating key and no raw content persistence. Added security checklist item and KMS integration note (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-secure-kms).

2025-02-18 - Marcus Li: Wire up continuity_token persistence in temporary in-memory session store; added unit tests for reconnect scenario. Observability team requested an additional metric 'chunk_continuity_recovered' to indicate reconnections that restored span linkage.

2025-02-20 - Design review: UX/Console team (Lina Gomez) asked for a compatibility shim that maps ChunkFlow fields to Dashboard's legacy fields to avoid breaking saved alerts. Lina provided mapping doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/ChunkFlow+Compatibility+Mapping
decisions: Use an HMAC-based pii_map_id derived from chunk-level normalized text + request_id + salt; do not store raw chunk text in metrics/ES.
Continuity token is a compact base64 string derived from request_id + initial_offset and persisted in a short-life session store; clients send it on reconnect to resume spans.
Adaptive sampling will default to 1% globally with per-customer override via routing policy; sampling decisions are emitted as 'sampled:true/false' in chunk headers.
Compatibility layer will expose a transformation endpoint that converts ChunkFlow v2 telemetry to legacy v1 shape for dashboards that cannot migrate yet.
tradeoffs: HMAC-based pii_map_id increases CPU on chunk creation (small), but avoids storing sensitive content which is critical for compliance.

Session store for continuity tokens introduces an operational surface and short TTL complexity; alternative was encoding full continuity info in token but that risked larger tokens and replay concerns.
Adaptive sampling reduces signal for debugging high-throughput customers; mitigating with deterministic sampling for flagged flows and on-demand full-capture via admin toggle.
notes: Related work: streaming span redaction tickets in /engineering suggested per-chunk redaction earlier; this ticket consolidates runtime + tracing + console mapping.
Conformance test plan needs to exercise reconnects across WebSocket and chunked HTTP streaming transports.
Console will need a query param to opt into 'show pii_map traces' for support investigators with appropriate role-based access.
testing_plan: Unit: chunk header emission and HMAC pii_map_id generation with deterministic test vectors
Integration: end-to-end stream with reconnect where continuity_token is provided; verify spans in tracing UI link to parent request
Security: run redaction verification suite to confirm that no raw chunk text is present in ES or application logs after enabling telemetry
Load: simulate 5k concurrent streaming clients with default sampling to validate metrics cardinality and session-store load
rollout_plan: Canary: Enable ChunkFlow telemetry for 5% of traffic on a non-critical route; monitor 'chunk_continuity_recovered' and 'pii_map_misses' metrics
Expand: Increase to 25% after 48 hours if no regressions, then to 100% during off-peak maintenance window
Compatibility: Enable transform endpoint to serve legacy dashboards in parallel and deprecate after 3 months with migration guides
